resources.string: Backups on this phone, backup files, restore

A backup is made every day on this phone (the last 7 are kept), and before every app upgrade or restore. To keep a copy somewhere else, save or share a backup file (USB, SD card, Google Drive, WhatsApp). Tap a backup to restore it; hold to delete it.
No backups on this phone yet.
This is not a LekasPOS backup file.
This backup belongs to a different store than the data on this phone.

Everything on this phone will be replaced by the backup (a copy of the current data is kept first). Continue as the same till if the old phone is no longer used; choose a new till if both phones will be used.
The backup is ready. The app restarts to finish the restore.
Delete this backup from the phone?
This till syncs with other tills: after the restore it joins the store as a new till, and sync must be turned on again.
Keep every till of the store up to date through Google Drive

Sync keeps the products, prices, stock, sales, staff, customers and settings of every till in this store the same. It uses a hidden app folder in the store\'s Google Drive (it does not appear among your files, and no other app can read it). Selling never waits for sync: a till works offline and catches up when it is online again.
Tills sync by themselves every 30 minutes and shortly after sales, whenever they are online. Other tills join by turning on sync with the same Google account.
Sync needs Google Play services, which this phone does not have. Backups still work (Settings → Backup & restore).
Enter a name for this till.
Use the same Google account on every till of the store. The first till creates the store\'s sync folder; the others join it and receive its data.
Google needs you to sign in again before this till can sync.
The last sync did not finish: %1$s. It is tried again automatically.
This till stops syncing. Its data stays on this phone and the other tills keep theirs. Turning sync on again sends this till\'s data again.
Another till in this store has the same till number. Make a backup, then restore it on this phone as a new till, and turn on sync again.
You signed in as %1$s, but this till syncs with %2$s. Sign in with %2$s, or turn sync off and on again to move the store to another account.
